east_catalysts_risks.notes: The window (17-20 Oct 2026) produced almost no east-Bengaluru catalyst news in the search index. The only in-window item found is the 19 Oct Deccan Herald report of an advocate shot dead outside his Whitefield home. That page returned 403, so I could quote only its headline. The Asianet and Times of India leads could not be reached: Asianet did not surface in search, and TOI is blocked for fetch. The TOI lead is also undated and its location is unconfirmed. No in-window items turned up for the Purple Line, Sarjapur-Hebbal metro, suburban rail, STRR, PRR/BBC, OMR/Hoskote, Cauvery supply, Varthur/Bellandur flooding or ORR leasing; I could not reach the Deccan Herald Sarjapur-Hebbal piece to date it. The claims above are pre-window background and are dated as such. Search summaries (not opened pages) also mention these items, which I did not report as claims because I could not quote or verify them: a BDA Bengaluru Business Corridor package of about Rs 3,500 crore (reported June 2026); Sarjapur-Hebbal central approval expected around October with a revised cost of Rs 25,999 crore; Infineon leasing about 6.3 lakh sq ft at Brigade Solarium City; and a possible Old Madras Road metro extension (feasibility stage only). The Pink Line opening was still unconfirmed in the latest reports I found (early to mid October).

east_launches_prices.notes: No confirmed East Bengaluru launch, new phase or RERA registration was found published inside 17-20 Oct 2026. The only in-window item is the Sattva Whitefield pre-launch marketing page (updated 20 Oct), which is not an official announcement. Searches mostly returned stale (2025 to mid-2026) developer and listing content. Neither lead (advocate shot dead in Whitefield) could be found by headline, and neither is a launch or price item. The Karnataka RERA portal and developer press pages were not reachable through the search tool, so absence of evidence here is not proof that no launch happened.

government_watch.notes: I found no verifiable government or infrastructure development published or materially updated between 2026-10-17 06:00 IST and 2026-10-20 06:00 IST. The WebSearch results skewed to older items. Deccan Herald returned 403 and The Hindu was refused by the fetch tool, so the 20 Oct 'Rs 1 lakh crore mobility plan' articles (Deccan Herald, News Karnataka), the Pink Line underground cost story (Dailyhunt), the Hebbal Short Tunnel NGT story (The Hindu) and the Kasturinagar saplings story were not found or opened. Treat those leads as unverified. Searches returned nothing dated October 2026 for GBA tenders, BWSSB, BDA, KIADB, Karnataka RERA, stamp duty or guidance value, or Karnataka Cabinet decisions. The Pink Line elevated section had no confirmed CMRS clearance or opening date in anything I found. Most recent reports I found, around 8 October, put the CMRS inspection at 6-8 October with a possible opening after 15 October. The four claims above are background only, and the Hebbal NGT and Pink Line cost leads should be re-checked directly on the outlets' sites. No RERA numbers were checked on the portal. The Hosur/Attibele metro and Sobha Q2 profit leads were not corroborated by a primary source.

metro_watch.notes: No Namma Metro/K-RIDE item published inside the window (17–20 Oct 2026) could be verified. The metrorailnews.in Bengaluru list (to 19 Oct) shows nothing in-window for Bengaluru; its latest are 16 Oct (Pink Line 36 safety issues) and 13 Oct (Shivakumar seeking PM's inauguration date), both before the window. All claims above are pre-window background. Pink Line elevated stretch: CMRS inspection 6–8 Oct, observations 9 Oct, no authorisation or opening date found as of 20 Oct. Not found or not fetched by search: Deccan Herald 20 Oct "fresh mobility plan, Rs 1 lakh crore" (DH returned 403; searches only surfaced older Rs 1/1.5 lakh crore tunnel-road/mobility pieces, with the Realty Today page dated Feb 2025), News Karnataka mobility plan, Dailyhunt Pink Line "Rs 1,000 crore/km", Trade Brains Hosur–Attibele, and The Hindu NGT Hebbal Short Tunnel item (search could not confirm an NGT order). No K-RIDE, fare, ridership-record or Dasara service news found for the window. Note: search tool summaries are model-generated; verify the Hebbal NGT lead and the DH 20 Oct article directly if they matter.

north_south_west.notes:
The window produced few verifiable items. Confirmed in-window: the NGT order (16 Oct, reported 18 Oct) halting tree felling for the Hebbal Short Tunnel, via two outlets; the Hindu original was blocked. Next hearing is 15 Dec. The Trade Brains Hosur vs Attibele piece (19 Oct) was found by headline only.

Not found or not verified: no new villa, plotted or apartment launch dated 17–20 Oct in the North, South or West focus areas. Devanahalli, Doddaballapur, Hoskote, Kanakapura Road, Bidadi, Yelahanka, Hebbal, Thanisandra, Electronic City, Bannerghatta Road, Mysore Road, Kengeri, Tumkur Road and Magadi Road were all searched.

Searches returned no matching pages for these leads, so none is reported as a claim:
- Hulimavu metro flooding (Deccan Herald)
- Kengeri Dasara traffic curbs
- Kanakapura Road/NICE tanker fire
- Thanisandra Traffic Park (The Hindu blocked)
- Trade Brains Jigani article
- Swan Realty Bodhi (Jayanagar, outside focus)
- Airport ganja seizures (not real estate)
- LuLu Daily JP Nagar jobs

Three search-snippet items had no fetched source and are left out for lack of a verbatim excerpt: the Deccan Herald Jigani–Anekal metro spur for the Surya City sports complex (page returned 403), Bengaluru Business Corridor tender status (March 2026), and the Mysuru Road–Magadi Road MAR corridor nearing completion.

The Pink Line stretch (Kalena Agrahara–Tavarekere, which includes Hulimavu) was inspected by CMRS on 6–8 Oct and has no opening date. Portal pages listing Prestige Forest Edge, Brigade Silvercrest, Godrej Castillo and others are undated marketing and are not reported as launches.

social_signals.notes: No in-window (2026-10-17 to 2026-10-20) social/video signals were found. Reddit blocked WebFetch, LinkedIn needed a login, and YouTube pages returned no video listings when logged out. Search results returned no public social posts and nothing dated in the window. All results were developer or portal blogs, such as Sobha, Brigade, Godrej and PropNewz, or older news from March to August 2026. These are interested-party and pre-window, so I did not report them as claims. This is a valid "nothing found", and it reflects the access limits, not proof that nothing was posted.
